vrcx_updater.updater_disabled: Updates come with new versions of the Android app.

user_generated_content.description: Prints, stickers and emoji you save are stored on this device. You can choose a different folder.

launch.game_running_warning: VRChat is running on your PC. Launch it on this device as well?

companion.title: PC companion
companion.intro: VRCX Companion runs on your Windows PC and sends VRChat's log to this device over your local network. It fills the game log and player list, and tells VRCX when VRChat is running.
companion.syncing_description: Copying new log lines from your PC.
companion.time_zone_description: Game log times use your PC's time zone.
companion.forget_confirm_description: This device stops receiving the game log from this PC. You can pair it again at any time.
companion.pair_description: On your PC, open VRCX Companion from the system tray and choose Pair new device. It shows a QR code and a pairing code for 5 minutes.
companion.scan_description: Point the camera at the QR code on your PC.
companion.discover_description: Your device and your PC need to be on the same network.
companion.discover_none: No PCs found. Check that VRCX Companion is running, or enter the address instead.
companion.pairing_closed: Choose Pair new device on the PC first
companion.manual_description: Use the address shown in VRCX Companion, for example 192.168.1.20:49460.
companion.address_prompt_description: Enter the address shown in VRCX Companion. The port is optional.
companion.code_prompt_description: Enter the pairing code shown on your PC.
companion.code_invalid: The pairing code has 10 letters and numbers, like ABCDE-12345.

errors.code: That code doesn't match. Check the code on your PC and try again.
errors.expired: The pairing code has expired. Choose Pair new device on your PC to get a new one.
errors.closed: Pairing isn't open on your PC. Choose Pair new device in VRCX Companion.
errors.unreachable: Can't reach your PC. Check that both devices are on the same network and that VRCX Companion is running.
errors.not_local: That address isn't on your local network. VRCX only connects to PCs on your network.
errors.fingerprint: This PC's identity has changed. Forget it and pair again.

companion.data_description: Bring over your history from VRCX on your PC, or keep a copy of the data on this device.
companion.import_description: Pick VRCX.sqlite3, copied from the VRCX folder in AppData on your PC. It replaces the data on this device, then the app restarts.
companion.import_confirm_description: Everything VRCX has stored on this device is replaced by the file you pick, including saved logins. The app restarts when the import is done.
companion.export_description: Save a copy of this device's VRCX database. It contains saved logins, so keep it private.

system.background_description: Keeps notifications, the feed and the PC companion working while VRCX is closed. Android shows a notification while VRCX runs.
system.battery_unrestricted: VRCX can run in the background without restrictions.
system.battery_restricted: Android may pause VRCX in the background, which can delay notifications.
system.notification_denied: Blocked. Turn notifications on in Android settings.

empty.unpaired_title: Game log needs the VRCX Companion on your PC
empty.game_log_description: Joins, leaves and videos come from VRChat's log on your PC. Places you visit still show up from your VRChat account.
empty.player_list_description: The players in your instance come from VRChat's log on your PC.
empty.disconnected_description: VRCX catches up as soon as it can reach {name} again.

launch.failed: Couldn't open VRChat on this device.

media.folder_open_failed: Couldn't open this folder on your device.
